plugin.name: Scripted_Log_Names
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.description: Select this plugin's StartLog function in Logging Setup, then start logging normally. Installing or connecting never starts a log or sends a command. Edit the configuration below to request and parse a game's metadata. See docs/SCRIPTED_LOGGING.md. CancelLog cancels a pending request. Existing logs are never overwritten.

muclient.script:
-- BEGIN SCRIPTED LOG CONFIG local default_folder = GetInfo(58) if not default_folder or default_folder == "" then default_folder = "logs" end if not default_folder:match("^%a:[/\\]") and not default_folder:match("^\\\\") then default_folder = GetInfo(66):gsub("[/\\]+$", "") .. "/" .. default_folder end ScriptedLogConfig = { folder = default_folder, template = "{world}-{real_date}-{real_time}-{number}.txt", request_command = nil, start_regex = nil, end_regex = nil, fields = {}, required = {}, preserve_header = false, timeout = 30, max_records = 100, max_bytes = 65536, collision_attempts = 100, } -- END SCRIPTED LOG CONFIG
local starter local function Notify(message) ColourNote("orange", "", message) end local function LoadStarter() local helper = require "scripted_log_start" local host = { ok = error_code.eOK, world_id = GetWorldID, world_name = function() return GetInfo(2) end, connected = IsConnected, is_open = IsLogOpen, now = function() return utils.timer() end, timestamp = os.time, text_mode = function() return GetOption("log_html") == 0 and GetOption("log_raw") == 0 end, send = Send, open_exclusive = function(path) return OpenLogExclusive(path) end, write = WriteLog, close = CloseLog, notify = Notify, exists = function(path) local file = io.open(path,"rb") if file then file:close();return true end return false end, compile = function(pattern) local expression = rex.new(pattern) return function(line) local first,last,captures = expression:match(line) if first then return captures or {} end end end, } return helper.new(ScriptedLogConfig,host) end function StartLog(action) if action ~= nil and action ~= "start" then Notify("Log start failed: unrecognized start action.");return end if starter and starter.pending then starter:cancel("requested by another start action");return end local ok,result = pcall(LoadStarter) if not ok then Notify("Log start failed: "..tostring(result));return end starter=result local started,problem=pcall(function() return starter:start() end) if not started then starter:cancel("script error",true);Notify("Log start failed: "..tostring(problem)) end end function CancelLog() if starter then starter:cancel("requested by user") end end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if starter then starter:on_line(line) end return true end function OnPluginTick() if starter then starter:tick() end end function OnPluginDisconnect() if starter then starter:cancel("originating world disconnected") end end function OnPluginDisable() if starter then starter:cancel("plugin disabled") end end function OnPluginClose() if starter then starter:cancel("plugin closed") end end
